name: Spelling Bee
description: Hear a word and spell it with the bee keyboard. Three levels in English or Spanish, clues, slow mode and three lives.
prompt: A spelling bee game: the phone says a word out loud and you spell it with a big on-screen keyboard, in English or Spanish, three levels of difficulty, a slow mode that spells it letter by letter, clues, three lives and stars per level.
author: gonzaroman
